recognize_zh: 低倍下組織碎片被密集、單調的小型深染細胞瀰漫取代，正常結構幾乎看不到；單憑這張低倍圖無法確定是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤，需要高倍找 Dutcher body 及免疫染色佐證。
features: Multiple tissue fragments diffusely effaced by a dense, cellular infiltrate
Infiltrating cells are small with dark nuclei at this magnification
Vaguely nodular to sheet-like architecture with scattered pink stromal/vascular structures
No recognizable normal tissue elements (follicles, fat, or trilineage hematopoiesis) in the fields shown
Cytologic detail (plasmacytoid features, Dutcher bodies) not resolvable at this power
describe_en: Low-power H&E sections show fragments of tissue diffusely replaced by a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphoid-appearing cells with scattered small vessels and eosinophilic stromal elements. Normal architecture is not identifiable in the fields shown. Cytologic details, including plasmacytoid differentiation and intranuclear inclusions, cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In the clinical context, the findings are compatible with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma such as lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, but high-power examination, immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD138, kappa/lambda), and MYD88 L265P testing are required.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MZL often shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells and follicular colonization and usually lacks MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein.
CLL/SLL shows proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+, unlike LPL.
MCL is composed of cells with irregular nuclei, hyalinized vessels and epithelioid histiocytes, and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Plasma cell neoplasms lack the clonal CD20+ small B-cell component and are usually CD56+ with non-IgM paraprotein.
